text:
morgan: Quick update — we flipped the straddle-rebalancer into a 60% canary on runtime-prod about 20m ago. Initial telemetry looks good: p50 gen latency down ~8%, p99 down ~12%, and token cost down ~18% on mixed text workloads. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/straddle-rebalancer-canary :tada:

deploy-bot: deploy completed: release=straddle-rebalancer-v1.3 env=prod canary=60% id=rel_2026_03_22_14:02

jia: awesome. any regressions on safety/response quality detected by the eval hooks?

morgan: no quality regressions so far — eval-set drift <0.3% and hallucination checks unchanged. We ran the eval-suite twice (staging -> canary).

alex: do we have an easy rollback command if p99 degrades? want to make sure SRE can flip fast during peak.

morgan: rollback command is in the runbook and also here: `rde deploy rollback --release rel_2026_03_22_14:02 --to 0% --force` (this will scale canary down instantly).

ana: please tag the rollout in the incident-runbook and add a note under "pack/merge" about cross-slab packing behavior. small teams rely on the KV cache semantics.

morgan: will do. Adding a short note now and pinging product. Also opening a tiny postmortem checklist in Notion for the flip window.

jia: can we capture a quick before/after cost-per-token snapshot for billing? product would like the numbers.

morgan: yes — pulled hourly agg from 00:00 to canary-start and will share after the 24h window. Early rough: cost/token improvement concentrated on short-seq (<128) requests.

alex: :thumbsup:  glad to see the hetero-batching + straddle heuristics paying off. Any follow-ups planned?

morgan: next steps: (1) finish 24h canary and run load-blast at 80% traffic next Tue; (2) extend to dedicated pools with slightly different slab sizes; (3) add extra traces to the hotpath for debugging. Will post a short summary if the full rollout begins.

ana: noted. tagging infra oncall to eyeball latency during the 80% blast.

morgan: thanks — pinging @oncall for the Tuesday blast window.

deploy-bot: alert: scheduled load-blast at 2026-03-24T14:00Z for release=rel_2026_03_22_14:02 target=80%

jia: :raised_hands: great job team!
